mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_alerts ( alert_id, idempotency_key, payload_hash, organization_id, location_id, device_uuid, alert_type, severity, status, rule_id, occurred_at, created_at, lambda_assignment_id, lambda_id, lambda_version_id, run_id, event_key, changes_json) SELECT #{alertId,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.UuidStringTypeHandler}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, l.organization_id, #{locationId}, #{deviceUuid}, #{alertType}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{ruleId}, #{occurredAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{lambdaAssignmentId}, #{lambdaId}, #{lambdaVersionId}, #{runId}, #{eventKey}, #{changesJson,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.JsonStringTypeHandler} FROM locations l WHERE l.location_id = #{locationId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
